yard: a fenced homestead yard. A low wattle fence runs around the whole picture close to its edges, with a gap at the bottom center where a footpath leaves. Top center, filling the middle half of the width and the upper half of the height: a large log hut seen from above with its roof cut away (dollhouse cutaway): earthen floor, a clay fire pit in its left half, plank sleeping benches in its right half, a door in the middle of its lower wall. Above the hut, at the very top center, a small dug vegetable patch. A trodden footpath runs from the hut door straight down to the fence gap. The rest is bare trampled earth with clear empty spots in the four corners and along the left and right sides, nothing built there. A few reed tufts by the fence.
shore: a river shore. The upper third is slate-blue river water with small waves and light mist; below it a dark wet edge, then a wide grey sand beach. A pile of bleached driftwood on the left side a little below the middle; a scatter of round pebbles on the right side a little below the middle; a few shells. A footpath comes up from the bottom center and bends to the left toward the water.
reeds: a reed marsh. Dense tall reed beds along the top edge and the sides. A still dark pool on the right side just below the middle; a narrow water channel crossing the left half just below the middle; a patch of grey mud on the left below the channel. A trodden path runs from the bottom center straight up through the reeds to the top. Open trodden spots at the top left, top center and top right among the reeds.
saltflat: a salt flat. White salt crust cracked into big plates, dark mud showing in the cracks, a few salt mounds. A faint footpath from the bottom center to an open spot just above the middle.
brine: a brine well. In the upper middle a square frame of old logs over a pit of black brine, a wooden trough beside it and a broken well sweep (a long pole on a post). Grey salty ground with white crust around. A footpath from the bottom center up to the log frame.
grove: a flooded forest. Old birches, alders and oaks stand knee-deep in still dark water across the whole picture. A winding ridge of firmer mossy ground runs from the bottom center to the top. Fallen branches, a big fallen log on the right side below the middle, moss on the trunks.
dyke: an old dam. Along the very top a strip of dark dammed water. Below it, across the full width, a thick old stone dyke wall with three wooden sluice gates, the middle one bigger. Below the middle gate a small round pool from the spillway. Old fallen stone blocks on the left and the right below the dyke, grass and weeds in the lower left. A footpath from the bottom center up to the pool.
causeway: a bog crossed by a log causeway. Dark bog water pools on the left side and on the right side, tussocks and sedge between them. A causeway of logs laid side by side runs from the bottom center up to a palisade of sharpened stakes that stretches across the upper part of the picture.
road: a wide steppe road. A beaten dirt road with deep wheel ruts runs from the bottom center up the picture. Along the right edge a shallow river with a stony ford crossing near the top right. On the left near the top a ring of wooden ox carts; tall dry grass on the left below the middle.
town: a small riverside trading town seen from above. A river runs along the LEFT edge only, from the top-left corner down to the bottom-left corner; a wooden pier sticks out into it on the left a little below the middle. A small creek in the top right corner. An open market square with a big wooden salt scale exactly in the center, a little above the middle. A larger log hall with a steep roof in the top left; a tavern with a porch in the top right by the creek. Thatched and shingled houses with gabled roofs along the streets, salt piles under awnings. The main street is dry land and runs straight from the bottom edge at the center up to the market; the bottom of the picture is dry ground, no water there.
bog: a dark peat bog. Black water pools, tussocks of sedge, cranberry patches on the right near the top, old digging pits with rusty water on the left near the top and in the middle at the top, stacked cut peat. A winding footpath from the bottom center up to the top.
isle: a small river island. Open slate-blue water all around; in the middle a hump of sand with willow bushes and a few trees; a small wooden boat pulled up on the sand at the bottom center; reeds on the right edge of the island; a mud bank on the left in the water.
willow: an old willow stand by the water. Old pollarded willows with thick trunks on the left half, their shoots cut for withies; on the right side, from the middle down, open water with reeds; a weathered wooden post near the middle. A footpath winds from the bottom center up to the top.
quarry: an old sand quarry pit at the foot of a town on the steppe. A big sandy pit with steep yellow walls fills most of the picture; rough refugee shelters of sacking and branches clustered along the right wall near the top; a campfire sunk in a hole in the upper middle; clay diggings cut into the left wall near the top; tall dry steppe grass above the pit along the bottom right; a sandy ramp path coming in from the bottom center. Open trampled sand around those places.
workshop: a craftsman's workshop yard on the edge of a small southern Ukrainian town. A low whitewashed wattle-and-daub fence runs around the whole picture close to its edges, with a wooden gate in the middle of the bottom edge. Top left, by the fence: a wooden notice board under a tiny shingle roof with scraps of paper pinned to it. Top center: an open-sided shed with its roof cut away (dollhouse cutaway): a long carpenter's workbench, tools hanging on the back wall, curls of wood shavings on the floor. Top right: a small stone forge with leather bellows, an anvil on an oak stump and a wooden quench tub. Right side, a little below the middle: the corner of a whitewashed cottage with a thatched roof and a clay bake-oven by its door; cherry trees behind it. Along the left side: a neat stack of oak planks and a bundle of willow rods. The center and the lower middle are open trodden earth with a footpath from the gate to the shed, with clear empty spots left and right of the path a little below the center. An old pear tree in the bottom right corner.
kryvets: the market square of a small southern Ukrainian river town in peacetime. Top left: two rows of market stalls under striped canvas awnings with barrels, baskets of apples and bundles of cloth. Top center: the iron row: an open smithy stall with iron rods, horseshoes and pots hanging, a cart beside it. Top right: a whitewashed wooden church with a small green onion dome and a low fence with a bench in front. Between them and below: an open dusty square with a stone well slightly left of center. The lower middle stays open dusty ground with clear empty spots a little left and right of center. At the bottom center a lane leaves the square between two whitewashed cottages with orchards; poplars along the left and right edges.
hutir: a hunter's homestead on a low island ridge in the middle of river marshes. Slate-blue water and reed beds fill the left, right and bottom edges; the island is a long low ridge of dry earth across the middle. Top left: a trodden yard with a small wattle chicken pen and a vegetable patch dug up in places. Top center: a small smokehouse of clay and wattle with a thin plume of smoke and fish drying on rods. Top right: an open lean-to shed with a workbench, bows and nets hanging. Right side, a little below the middle: a small whitewashed hut with a reed-thatched roof and a bench by the door. Bottom center: a narrow wooden landing stage with a flat-bottomed boat tied to it. The center and the lower middle are open trodden ground with clear empty spots a little left and right of center. Willows along the edges.
brid: a river ford and ferry crossing with a little settlement in peacetime. A wide slate-blue river runs across the right third of the picture from top to bottom. Top left: carts of fur and hide traders with bundles of pelts hanging on poles. Top center: a long low tavern of whitewashed clay with a reed roof and a porch over the water's edge. Top right, on the river: a big flat wooden ferry raft on a rope stretched across the river, a wooden pier. The center and the lower middle are open dusty trampled ground with ruts of cart wheels and clear empty spots a little left and right of center; at the bottom center a road leaves between two willows.
ashtown: the market square of a small southern Ukrainian river town after it was burned in war. Top left: charred posts and collapsed frames of market stalls, scorched barrels, ash. Top center: the iron row: a burnt-out smithy stall with only its stone forge and an anvil left standing, a broken cart beside it. Top right: a whitewashed church with its onion dome gone and blackened roof beams, a broken low fence. Between them and below: an open square of ash and trampled mud with a stone well with a sweep slightly left of center, still standing. The lower middle stays open ground with clear empty spots a little left and right of center. At the bottom center a lane leaves the square between two burnt-out cottages with only their white clay stoves standing; charred poplars along the left and right edges. Thin smoke still rises from a few places.
ashisle: a hunter's homestead on a low island ridge in the middle of river marshes, burned down. Slate-blue water and reed beds fill the left, right and bottom edges; the island is a long low ridge of dry earth across the middle. Top left: a trodden yard with a broken wattle pen and a young apple tree without leaves. Top center: a collapsed clay smokehouse, blackened, with a thin wisp of smoke. Top right: rows of charred net poles stuck in the ground where a shed burned away. Right side, a little below the middle: the blackened walls of a small hut without a roof, a stone bench by the door. Bottom center: a narrow wooden landing stage, half burned, with no boat. The center and the lower middle are open trodden ground with ash, with clear empty spots a little left and right of center. Burnt willows along the edges.
yhouse: a widow's homestead at the very end of a village street, late autumn. A low wattle fence runs around the whole picture close to its edges, with a gap at the bottom center where a footpath leaves to the street. Top, across the middle three quarters of the width and the upper third of the height: a whitewashed clay-and-log cottage seen from above with its thatched roof cut away (dollhouse cutaway): in its left part a big white clay stove with a bench beside it; in its middle, under a small window, a wooden weaving loom with a half-woven red-and-white cloth; in its right part a carved wooden chest; a table with benches near the door in the middle of its lower wall. Left side, a little above the middle, near the fence: a well with a tall wooden sweep (a long pole on a forked post). Right side, a little above the middle: an open woodshed with stacked firewood and a chopping block with an axe. Left side, lower: a low earthen cellar mound covered with turf, with a wooden hatch. The center and the lower middle are open trodden earth with a footpath from the cottage door to the fence gap, and clear empty spots left and right of the path a little below the middle. A dug-over vegetable plot along the right side at the bottom, two yellow ash trees beyond the fence at the top corners.
ysquare: a small northern village square, late autumn. Top center: a tall wooden bell tower on four thick legs with three bronze bells under a shingle roof, ropes hanging down. Top left: a village smithy, an open-fronted log forge with a stone hearth glowing, an anvil on an oak stump, a water tub, thin smoke. Top right: a richer house with a tin roof and carved white window frames, a porch with three steps. Left side, a little above the middle: a long low communal log house with a notice board on its wall and a bench along it. Right side, a little above the middle: a tall plank barn with big double doors, shut. Left side, lower: a dog kennel with a chain by the smithy's side wall (no dog). Right side, lower: a small whitewashed cottage with a thin, holey old thatch. The center: an open trodden square of packed earth with a ring of stones for a fire; the lower middle stays open with clear empty spots left and right of center; a lane leaves at the bottom center between wattle fences.
ymill: a wooden water mill on a small creek, late autumn. A narrow creek with willows and reeds enters from the left edge a little above the middle and runs across the upper half to the right, where a low wooden dam with a sluice holds a small mill pond. Top, left of center: the mill house seen from above with its roof cut away (dollhouse cutaway): a pair of round millstones, a wooden hopper, sacks of flour. Top right: a big wooden undershot water wheel on the side of the mill over the mill race by the dam. Left side, a little above the middle: thick reeds and old willows along the creek bank. Right side, a little above the middle: a small yard behind a wattle fence with a farm cart standing on three wheels, the fourth wheel lying broken by the fence. The lower half: an open meadow with a footpath from the bottom center up to the mill, with clear empty spots left and right of the path.
yapiary: an old beekeeper's apiary at the very edge of a dark pine forest, late autumn. Tall dark pines stand along the whole top edge. Top left: two rows of upright hollow-log beehives under small bark roofs. Top right: a half-dug earthen winter bee shelter with a turf roof and a low plank door. Right side, a little above the middle: a tiny low old hut with a smoking chimney, a bench by the door and a dark slate board leaning against the wall. The lower half: open grass with fallen pine needles, a footpath from the bottom center to the hut, with clear empty spots left and right of the path; a few tree stumps.
ypines: the edge of a dark old pine forest above a village pasture, late autumn. The upper half is dense dark pine forest; a narrow game trail goes into the forest at the top center and disappears in the dark. Left side, upper: a sandy bank under the roots of a fallen pine with several dark burrow holes. Right side, upper: a big old elder bush with clusters of black berries growing over an old overgrown hearth stone. The lower half: an open common pasture with yellow autumn grass and a low wattle pen for cattle on the left, piles of dry fallen pine branches on the right, a footpath from the bottom center, clear empty spots left and right of center.
yhill: a small old village graveyard on top of a low hill, late autumn. Top center: one big old weathered standing stone, larger than the others, with a carved round leaf-like emblem (no letters). Around it across the upper half: carved wooden grave posts with little roofs, low grey stones, grassy mounds. Left side, a little above the middle: a group of old ash trees with yellow leaves and a plank bench under them. The lower half: an open grassy slope with fallen yellow leaves, a footpath winding up from the bottom center, with clear empty spots left and right of the path. Far away beyond the hill, at the very top edge, a glimpse of a river and white chalk bluffs.
